name: First Family
oracle_text: You draw X cards and gain X life, where X is the number of colors among permanents you control and spells you've cast this turn.
blocked_sentences: You draw X cards and gain X life, where X is the number of colors among permanents you control and spells you've cast this turn.

needs.what: a value counting the distinct colors (0-5, colorless never counting) across the union of permanents you control (derived colors) and the spells you've cast this turn (read from the per-turn cast ledger, this spell included), e.g. {"distinct": {"of": "color", "objects": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you"}, "spells_cast_this_turn": "you"}}, usable as the amount of draw and gain_life
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `distinct` accepts only of: power, basic_land_type or card_type (DISTINCT_OF in engine/effects/values.py), so it cannot count colors; and its pool is an objects selector over current objects, while `spells_cast_this_turn` returns only a count of spells (optionally filtered), never their colors, so the colors of spells already resolved this turn cannot be read and unioned with the board's colors. A sum of five per-color `if exists` checks could cover the board half but still has no way to ask the colors of spells cast this turn, which have mostly left the stack.
